title: The Maharashtra Private Forests (Acquisition) Act, 1975
full_text: The Maharashtra Private Forests (Acquisition) Act, 1975 महाराष्ट्र खाजगी वने (संपादन) अधिनियम, १९७५. Long Title: An Act to acquire private forests in the State and to provide for certain other matters. Ministry: Ministry of Govt of Maharashtra Department: Revenue & Forest Department Type: STATE Location: Maharashtra TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles The Maharashtra Private Forests (Acquisition) Act, 1975 Show all section Section 1. Short title, extent, and commencement. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. Vesting of private forests in State Government. Section 4. Step to be taken by Government on acquisition of private forests. Section 5. Power to take over possession of Private Forests. Section 6. Settlement of disputes. Section 7. Payment of amount to owners of private forests. Section 8. Application for payment of amount. Section 9. Collector to determine amount. Section 10. Manner in which amount to be paid. Section 11. Deduction of amount of encumbrances from amount payable to owner. Section 12. Payment of amount for extinguishment of rights of other persons. Section 13. Appeals. Section 14. Procedure before Tribunal. Section 15. Limitation. Section 16. Court fees. Section 17. Finality of award and decision of Tribunal. Section 18. Revision. Section 19. Inquiries and proceedings before Collector and Tribunal to be judicial proceedings. Section 20. Indemnity. Section 21. Declaration of certain lands as private forests. Section 21A. Saving of certain afforested lands. Section 22. Owner of private forest to deliver records to authorised officers. Section 22A. Restoration of forest land to owner in certain circumstances. Section 22B. Power of Collector to grant private forest vested in the State for public purpose in certain cases. Section 23. Power to make rules. Section 24. Repeal of sections 34A to 37 of Forest Act.
